name: herd
description: A pixel border collie that watches all your sessions

recaps.title: Fresh recaps
recaps.description: After a turn ends, ask Haiku for a one-line recap of the session (at most one every 5 minutes). Off: no model calls; the panel shows only Claude Code's own recaps.

renames.title: Rename suggestions
renames.description: Now and then, offer a new session name based on the work (from the same Haiku call as the recap, so no extra tokens). At most once an hour per session.
